title: How most 16" Macbook Pros often kill themselves & why they're unfixable
summary: Louis Rossmann explains why many 16-inch MacBook Pros fail and are difficult to repair, focusing on power design on the logic board. He argues the design leads to failures that are hard to fix.
why: HN mentions are mostly critical or incidental, using it in discussions of Apple hardware design and repairability rather than recommending it.
